payload.question: Which next measurement most reduces the uncertainty in chlorine activation by satellite-reentry alumina: particle formation, surface chemistry, or atmospheric processing?
payload.target: log10 of reentry/background ClONO2+HCl activation rate, 15-30 km, high-latitude column

r_med_nm.source: Ferreira+2024 GRL: ~4 nm AlO clusters (MD); Maloney+2025 JGR brackets 0.01-1.7 um

sigma_g.source: lognormal width; unconstrained for reentry particles

oxide_fraction.source: Ferreira+2024: ~20-32% of Al oxidised; ESA 2026 workshop: metallic Al with oxide shell also found

w_lstrat_mm_s.source: calibrated 0.15 mm/s on Maloney+2025 10-30 km burden; +/- factor 2

tau_coat_days.source: Barker+2026 assumes immediate uptake into sulfate; Vattioni+2023 partial coating; Murphy+2023 metals inside H2SO4 particles

p_sep.source: coated particle stays separate (adds SAD) vs absorbed into existing droplet; unconstrained

gamma_alu.source: Molina+1997 ~0.02 near 210 K; Vattioni+2023: ~2 orders of magnitude extrapolation uncertainty

theta_hcl.source: Lostier+2026 ACS ESC: HCl coverage differs by orders of magnitude between minerals (296 K)

gamma_sulf.source: ClONO2+HCl on cold sulfate in polar lower stratosphere (JPL evaluation range)

payload.statement: Rapid mixing: alumina is coated by sulfate quickly, so bare-alumina chemistry contributes little.
payload.prediction: Median share of reentry activation on bare alumina < 10% (kinetic coating model).
payload.experiment: Morris screening + structural comparison + preposterior ranking

payload.statement: Persistent reactive surface: partial coating keeps bare alumina exposed long enough to dominate.
payload.experiment: Morris screening + structural comparison + preposterior ranking

payload.statement: Gas availability: HCl coverage limits activation more than the amount of surface.
payload.experiment: Morris screening + structural comparison + preposterior ranking

payload.statement: Microphysics: the initial size distribution controls the outcome more than any surface-chemistry rate.
payload.prediction: mu*(r_med_nm) is the largest Morris effect and the particle-formation measurement ranks first.
payload.falsified_if: another input has larger mu* or M3 is not ranked first
payload.experiment: Morris screening + structural comparison + preposterior ranking

payload.statement: Transport: the time to reach chemically favourable altitudes controls the outcome.
payload.experiment: Morris screening + structural comparison + preposterior ranking

options.risk: results are meaningless if transport is wrong

payload.why: Cheapest test that can invalidate every later result; gate before spending budget.

checks.reference: Maloney+2025 JGR: 20-40 Gg Al2O3 at 10-30 km for 10 Gg/yr (calibration target)
Maloney+2025 JGR: reaches ozone-layer altitudes in 1-3 yr with circulation (held out)
Maloney+2025 JGR: larger aerosol -> smaller stratospheric burden (held out, qualitative)
Ferreira+2024 GRL: ~30 yr for 4 nm particles by sedimentation alone (held out)
Mass balance: burden / input flux = mean residence time (positive, finite)

payload.reconciliation: Sedimentation-only transport (Ferreira) vs residual circulation (Maloney) explains the published 30 yr vs 1-3 yr gap: same 4 nm particles arrive with t50 2.6 yr once descent is included.

payload.why: Validated transport; next cheapest way to find which of 10 inputs matter.

payload.chosen: Spend the budget on structural (coating) uncertainty and measurement value; stop refining negligible transport inputs.

payload.evidence: largest mu* = p_sep; top measurement (kinetic) = M3

payload.criterion: top-1 measurement and top-3 set match the 3000-run reference in >=80% of seeds

measurement.name: Reentry-analog ablation particles: size distribution and oxide fraction (plasma wind tunnel)

payload.spec: Generate alumina particles under reentry-like ablation (plasma wind tunnel, 60-85 km pressure equivalents) and measure the number size distribution down to ~2 nm (SMPS/TEM) and the Al2O3 vs metallic-Al fraction. Target precision: median radius within a factor 1.5, oxide fraction +/-0.1.
payload.discriminates: H4 (microphysics) vs H1/H2 (coating): sets how much surface exists before coating matters.
payload.caveat: Value is computed inside this reduced-order model and its priors; it is a design assessment with hypothetical outcomes, not a measured reduction of physical uncertainty.
